subject.title: fix(net): cap default outbound HTTP connection pool limits

question: After fixing proxyline constructor propagation, should OpenClaw’s shared outbound proxy factories impose defaults of 256 connections per origin and 1024 total Node sockets?
rationale: The propagation defect is mechanical, but the numeric values become global throughput and queuing policy for core and plugin callers, which source inspection alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve bounded shared defaults
options.body: Adopt the proposed values after wiring them through proxyline and proving representative fresh-install and saturation behavior.

options.title: Narrow to Undici only
options.body: Land the independently correct Undici pool cap and defer Node limits until proxyline exposes and validates the policy.

options.title: Retain dependency defaults
options.body: Do not impose global fixed limits and redesign the protection around caller-owned or workload-specific limits.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded shared defaults
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed values after wiring them through proxyline and proving representative fresh-install and saturation behavior.
